CustomField.description: DIR-869: Internal guard against duplicate DOA orchestration launches. Revenue Cloud's repricing engine performs a rapid follow-up save right after any Discount edit, which can independently satisfy the DOA flow's entry criteria a second time and race for the record lock. Set true (before-save) the instant a submission qualifies; the orchestration's entry criteria checks PRIORVALUE() so only the first qualifying save proceeds. Reset to false only when the approval cycle concludes (Approved/Rejected/Recalled). Not exposed to users - grant read-only FLS (never editable) wherever Quote is creatable, matching the RES_System_Status_Update__c pattern, so the mandatory defaultValue doesn't block record creation.
CustomField.label: Discount Submission Lock
